name: How do interest rate changes impact the pre-construction market?

mainEntity.name: How do interest rate changes impact the pre-construction market?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interest rate changes can significantly affect the pre-construction market by influencing buyer affordability and developer financing costs. Higher rates may slow buyer demand, especially for projects with longer completion timelines where future mortgage rates are uncertain. Developers might also face increased borrowing costs, which could lead to project delays or adjustments in pricing. It's a practical tradeoff where potential savings from early purchase might be balanced against future financing costs. Kelby Contreras advises clients on navigating these financial considerations when evaluating pre-construction opportunities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interest rate changes impact pre-construction by affecting buyer affordability and developer costs, potentially slowing demand or altering project timelines and pricing. Consider future financing costs against early purchase benefits.
